dog.desc: a lean medium-sized medieval tracking hound (scent hound): short smooth coat in warm grey-brown with a lighter tan chest, muzzle and legs, long floppy dark brown ears, deep chest, long thin tail, a plain dark leather collar. Alert, sniffing, a working dog of hunters and soldiers.
dog.gait: Quadruped WALK cycle (dog trotting calmly): frame 1 = left foreleg and right hind leg forward, frame 2 = legs passing under the body, frame 3 = right foreleg and left hind leg forward, frame 4 = legs passing. Legs move in diagonal pairs with clearly visible stride in the side rows; in the front and back rows the legs alternate visibly. Head slightly lowered, tail swaying.

poses.sit: sitting on its haunches, front legs straight, head raised and alert, ears hanging, body turned three-quarter toward the RIGHT.
poses.lie: lying flat on its belly asleep, head resting on its stretched front paws, eyes closed, tail curled around, body along the ground facing RIGHT.
poses.attack: barking aggressively: front legs braced wide, head low and forward, mouth open showing teeth, hackles raised, tail stiff, facing RIGHT.

horse.desc: a strong medieval riding horse: dark bay coat (rich reddish-brown body) with a black mane, black tail and black lower legs, a small white star on the forehead. Tack: a simple dark brown leather saddle with stirrups and a dull grey saddle blanket edge, a dark leather bridle with reins resting on the neck. Realistic horse proportions (long legs, long neck), no rider.
horse.gait: Quadruped WALK cycle (horse walking calmly, four-beat walk): frame 1 = left foreleg and right hind leg stepping forward, frame 2 = legs passing, frame 3 = right foreleg and left hind leg stepping forward, frame 4 = legs passing. Clearly visible hoof steps in the side rows; head nods slightly; tail swings. In the front and back rows the legs alternate visibly.

poses.graze: grazing: standing with the head lowered all the way to the ground eating grass, neck stretched down, side profile facing RIGHT.
poses.rear: rearing up on its hind legs in panic, front legs kicking in the air, head thrown back, mane flying, facing RIGHT.

pig.desc: a stout medieval farm pig: pinkish skin with sparse bristly light hair and a few dark grey patches on the back and rump, upright pointed ears slightly folded forward, round snout, short legs with dark little trotters, small curly tail.
pig.gait: Quadruped WALK cycle (pig trotting): frame 1 = left foreleg and right hind leg forward, frame 2 = legs passing, frame 3 = right foreleg and left hind leg forward, frame 4 = legs passing. Short quick steps, belly swaying slightly, snout bobbing. Legs alternate clearly in all rows.

poses.lie: lying on its side asleep in the dirt, legs stretched out, eyes closed, belly up slightly, head on the RIGHT.

chicken.desc: a plump medieval brown farm hen: warm chestnut-brown feathers with darker speckled wing feathers and a golden neck, red comb and wattles, yellow beak, yellow legs and feet, short upturned tail.
chicken.gait: BIRD WALK cycle (hen strutting on two legs): frame 1 = left foot forward, head pushed forward, frame 2 = right foot lifted mid-step, head pulled back, frame 3 = right foot forward, head pushed forward, frame 4 = left foot lifted, head pulled back. Strong head bob, tail flicks.

poses.peck: pecking at the ground: body tipped forward, beak touching the ground, tail raised, facing RIGHT.

hare.desc: a wild European brown hare: tawny grizzled brown fur with a pale belly, very long ears with black tips, long powerful hind legs, large amber eyes, short tail black on top and white below.
hare.gait: HOPPING cycle (hare hopping slowly along): frame 1 = crouched with all four feet together, ears up, frame 2 = pushing off with the hind legs, body stretching long, front paws reaching forward, frame 3 = front paws landing while the hind legs swing past them, frame 4 = gathering back into a crouch. Ears stay upright.

poses.sit: sitting upright on its hind legs, alert and listening, ears straight up, front paws hanging, body turned three-quarter toward the RIGHT.

crow.desc: a glossy black carrion crow: solid black plumage with a faint blue-violet sheen, strong black beak, black legs and feet, dark eye.
crow.gait: BIRD WALK cycle (crow walking/hopping on the ground): frame 1 = left foot forward, frame 2 = right foot lifted mid-step, frame 3 = right foot forward, frame 4 = left foot lifted. Head bobs forward with every step, wings folded.

fly.cycle: frame 1 = wings raised high in a V above the body, frame 2 = wings level and spread wide, frame 3 = wings pushed fully down below the body, frame 4 = wings level again on the way up.

deer.desc: a red deer stag of the forest: reddish-brown summer coat, slightly darker neck with a light mane, pale cream rump patch and short tail, slender long legs with dark hooves, a proud head with a modest symmetrical eight-point antler crown, dark eyes and nose.
deer.gait: Quadruped WALK cycle (deer walking carefully): frame 1 = left foreleg and right hind leg forward, frame 2 = legs passing, frame 3 = right foreleg and left hind leg forward, frame 4 = legs passing. Elegant high steps, head held up. Legs alternate clearly in all rows.

poses.graze: grazing: head lowered to the ground eating grass, antlers pointing forward, side profile facing RIGHT.
poses.alert: standing completely still and alert, head raised high, ears turned forward, looking toward the RIGHT, one foreleg lifted, ready to flee.

items.desc: an old upright wooden barrel with dark iron hoops and a closed lid
a sturdy wooden crate made of planks with corner battens, closed lid
a full burlap grain sack tied at the top with a cord, standing upright and slightly slumped
a wooden water bucket with iron bands and a rope handle, filled with water
a small wooden keg lying on its side on a little wooden cradle stand, with a wooden tap at the front
a simple three-legged round wooden milking stool
a long rustic wooden bench made of a thick plank on four splayed legs, oriented left to right
a rustic rectangular farmhouse table of heavy oak planks on sturdy legs, empty top, oriented left to right
a big rounded haystack of golden dry hay, loose straws sticking out
a medieval two-wheeled wooden farm cart with high slatted sides, two big spoked wooden wheels and two long shafts resting on the ground, seen three-quarter from the front-left, empty
a round village well of grey fieldstones with a small wooden roof of shingles on two posts, a wooden crank winch with rope and a bucket hanging
a rustic wooden pigpen gate: a short section of split-rail fence with a simple swing gate of rough planks between two posts, a rope loop as latch, front view
a small A-frame travel tent of weathered beige canvas on wooden poles with guy ropes and pegs, the front flap open showing a dark inside

a large imposing black military command tent (a captain's pavilion) of heavy black canvas with a tall central pole, a black-and-white quartered pennant on top, white trim along the roof edge, front flaps tied open showing a dim inside, guy ropes and pegs
a wooden weapon rack with two spears, a sword and a wooden shield leaning in it
a straw training dummy: a wooden post with a crossbar as arms, a body of bound straw wrapped in a torn sackcloth, a sack head, standing in the ground, a few cuts in the straw
a black iron blacksmith anvil on a thick tree stump, a hammer leaning against it

a weathered wooden signpost at a crossroads: one tall post with two blank arrow-shaped wooden boards, one pointing LEFT and one pointing RIGHT, the boards are completely EMPTY and blank (no writing, no symbols), a small stone pile at the foot

a tall war banner on a wooden pole with a crossbar: a long rectangular hanging cloth quartered in BLACK and WHITE (four quarters like a chessboard, top-left black, top-right white, bottom-left white, bottom-right black), with a pointed iron spear tip on top, pole stuck upright in the ground

a tall war banner on a wooden pole with a crossbar: a long rectangular hanging cloth in royal BLUE and golden YELLOW (vertical halves, blue left, yellow right) with a stylised white falcon emblem in the centre, golden fringe, pole stuck upright in the ground
a fallen, torn blue-and-white war banner with a white bird-of-prey emblem lying crumpled on the ground, its broken pole beside it, mud stains
a broken wooden spear lying flat on the ground in two pieces, the iron tip on one piece, splintered break
a dented round wooden shield with a black-and-white painted front and an iron boss lying flat on the ground, slightly tilted
a fresh grave mound: an elongated low cairn of grey and brown fieldstones piled over fresh dark earth, about two metres long, oriented left to right
a second fresh grave cairn of piled grey fieldstones over dark earth, slightly shorter and rounder than a normal grave, a few larger flat stones on top, oriented left to right
a small loose pile of about eight rounded grey fieldstones of different sizes
a small bundle of dry brown twigs and brushwood for a campfire lying on the ground

a wooden farmhouse rocking cradle seen from above at three-quarter angle, with TWO sleeping newborn babies lying side by side, swaddled in cream linen with only their tiny faces visible, eyes closed, a soft wool blanket

a long moss-green hooded wool rain cloak laid out completely FLAT on the ground as a bedroll, seen from high above: the cloak fully opened and spread out like a blanket (a long rounded rectangle of green cloth), the flattened hood at the top end, a small bronze clasp, no person, not standing, not worn
a rumpled brown-and-cream wool blanket lying spread on the ground, folded back at one corner
a stack of four old leather-bound books of different colours (brown, green, red, dark blue) lying on top of each other
a worn closed storybook bound in dark blue leather with a small golden star on the cover, lying in a little patch of green grass
a short faded red cloth hair ribbon lying tangled in a few golden straws
two tiny honey-coloured round wooden beads lying on a bit of dark earth, catching the light
an unlit fire pit: a ring of grey stones around a few charred black logs and grey ash, no fire, no smoke
a short thick beeswax candle in a simple brass dish holder, NOT lit, the black wick showing, a thin wisp of smoke
a small round bird nest of woven twigs and moss with TWO fluffy grey-brown fledglings sitting in it with their yellow beaks open
the same small round bird nest of woven twigs and moss now with THREE fluffy grey-brown fledglings sitting in it, beaks open
a single tiny fluffy grey-brown fledgling bird sitting alone on the ground, small yellow beak, scruffy downy feathers

a long moss-green hooded wool rain cloak laid out completely FLAT on the ground as a bedroll, seen from high above: the cloak fully opened and spread out like a blanket (a long rounded rectangle of green cloth), the flattened hood at the top end, a small bronze clasp, no person, not standing, not worn

campfire.motion: the flames flicker and change shape from frame to frame, sparks rise
campfire.desc: a small campfire: a ring of grey stones around crossed burning logs with bright orange-yellow flames and glowing embers

lantern.motion: the candle flame inside flickers and the warm glow pulses gently
lantern.desc: an old iron lantern with glass panes and a ring handle on top, standing on the ground, a warm candle flame glowing inside

torch.motion: the fire at the top flickers and changes shape, a few sparks
torch.desc: a tall standing torch: a wooden pole stuck in the ground with a pitch-soaked rag head burning with a bright orange flame at the top

candle.motion: the small flame sways and flickers slightly
candle.desc: a short thick beeswax candle in a simple brass dish holder, burning with a small flame
